pool.text: The state was founded in Bhopal by Dost Mohammad Khan, a Pashtun soldier.
The new territory came under the suzerainty of the Nizam of Hyderabad.
The Marathas defeated the Mughals and the Nawab of Bhopal in battle.
Bhopal became a princely state after signing a treaty with the British.
Sikandar was proclaimed as king for supporting the British during the revolt.
Railways started in Bhopal when a specific section of the line opened.
The Nawab signed the agreement for Bhopal's merger with the Union.
Bhopal became the capital of the newly-formed Madhya Pradesh state.
The new Bhopal district was established, ending its part in Sehore.
Bhopal Development Authority was set up under a specific act for planning.
A national park was declared, covering an area of about 4.45 sq.
Bhopal Municipal Council got the status of Municipal Corporation with wards.
A Union Carbide pesticide plant leaked a mixture of deadly gases.
Bhoj Wetland was declared as a designated Ramsar site.
UNESCO declared Bhimbetka Caves as a World Heritage Site.
International flights began operations in the city.
An interstate bus terminus was inaugurated near the railway station.
Badshahs defeated Chandigarh Comets in the inaugural match of World Series Hockey.
The Bus Rapid Transit System opened, run by Bhopal City Link Limited.
Kolar Municipal Corporation merged with the main municipal corporation.
